name: DeepScientist
description: Local-first autonomous research studio that runs baselines, experiments and paper drafting through an existing coding-agent CLI.
whatItDoes: Keeps a long-running research loop going on your own machine: reproducing baselines, trying ideas, recording failures and wins, and writing up results. It is aimed at ML researchers.
howItWorks: It wraps a coding-agent runner (Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code or OpenCode) in a persistent workspace that stores findings across rounds. You install it from npm, authenticate the runner and launch it in a project directory.

requirements.name: Coding agent CLI
requirements.description: A working Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code or OpenCode install with its login

models: Whatever the chosen runner uses (Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, OpenCode)
